Well, she did say that jet lag often becomes more of a problem after 40, so I guess I'm lucky that I can still adjust to different time zones well.
我的问题是，我害怕坐飞机。
My problem is I'm afraid to fly.
哦，我不知道。

Actually, my mother is terrified of airplanes to the point where she can't even fly, so our family vacations were always by car or train.
我没那么糟糕。

我每次坐飞机前都会感到焦虑。在场的整个过程中我都感到紧张。空气，所以我才希望电视节目会更详细地报道这个话题。确实如此。

是的，那段内容太短了，尤其是……很多人都有这个问题。
Yeah, that segment was too brief, especially as so many people have that problem.
